(…) canticle (o’donnell) blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who has blessed us in christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places. he chose us in him before the foundation of the world that we should be holy and blameless before him. he destined us in love to be his sons through jesus christ, according to the purpose of his will, to the praise of his glorious grace which he freely bestowed on us in the beloved. (…) organ postlude: psalm prelude news november lists of the dead are available at the doors - please return your list before 2 november. it can be dropped into any of the petition boxes, or left into the ofïce. guided holy hour on monday next at 8:00pm. youth 2000 gathering on wednesday next at 7:00pm. drop-in bereavement support is offered by the cathedral bethany group on thursday next, 29 october, between 7:0pm and 8:00pm. the offertory collection last sunday came to €3,046.90: our sincere thanks to all who continue to support the cathedral financially. mission sunday collection — thank you for your response to last sunday’s collection, which realised a total of €1,783.66. celebrations this week — feast of ss simon & jude, apostles (28 october); optional memorials of st otteran, monk (27 october; a feast in the diocese of waterford), st colman, bishop (29 october; a feast in the diocese of kilmacduagh), and bl. dominic collins, martyr (31 october; a feast in the diocese of cloyne). in the diocese of cork & ross and the diocese of cloyne, bl. thaddeus maccarthy, bishop (25 october), is not celebrated this year as the sunday of ordinary time takes precedence. other news novena to st martin takes place in the dominican church, claddagh, between monday 26 october and tuesday 3 november, with mass daily at 7:30pm (sunday 12:00 noon). the preacher is fr damian polly op . support evening for bereaved parents , run by anam cara, takes place on wednesday 4 november at 7:30pm in the maldron hotel, sandy road, galway, and is open to all bereaved parents regardless of the age of the child who died, the circumstances of their death or how recently they died. “christ’s poor little man” is a talk on devotion to st francis of assisi in medieval ireland, to be given in mountbellew pastoral centre (h53 y9k4) on tuesday 10 november at 8:00pm. the talk is given by br colmán ó clabaigh osb of glenstal abbey. cathedral cleaning team the team of dedicated volunteers who clean the cathedral every thursday morning could use some new members. if you can give some time between 9:30am and 11:00am on a thursday, please come along and grab a brush! sat 6:00 mary burke sun 9:00 mary bernadette mcmahon 10:30 tom rushe 12:30 robert martin herron 6:00 therese kelly mon 11:00 mary corbett tue 11:00 peadar duignan 6:00 margaret ridge wed 11:00 john cavanagh 6:00 donal bell thur 11:00 margaret conneely 6:00 patricia talbot fri 11:00 alan & mary hobbs 6:00 golden book of remembrance sat 11:00 jim smyth 6:00 teresa o’brien sun 10:30 maureen & johnny ward 12:30 maureen tobin (month’s mind) 6:00 golden book of remembrance mass intentions this week masses for the living are not listed here, though are celebrated as usual. candlelight rosary concludes this evening at 8:00pm. galway cathedral
